description: Auenzustand - Verlust von Überschwemmungsflächen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodienste.bfn.de. Calculation of the proportion of the Altaue in the morphological floodplain (without river area) per kilometre segment separated by right and left bank. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Floodplain condition — loss of flood areas" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Flussaue, Landnutzung, Schutzgebiet, Deutschland, opendata, Bund. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://sg.geodatenzentrum.de/web_public/gdz/lizenz/geonutzv.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
